```python
import sys
import os
import json
import re
import numpy as np
import cv2

def main():
    try:
        image_path = sys.argv[1]
    except Exception:
        image_path = ""

    ocr_text = "1.0\nDataset Type\n0.5\nColor\nGrayScale\nSegmented\n0.4\nEpochs"

    result = {
        "type": "other",
        "description": "无法确定图片类型",
        "important_components": [],
        "code_relevant_information": ""
    }

    img = None
    white_ratio = 0.0
    h = w = 0

    try:
        data = np.fromfile(image_path, dtype=np.uint8)
        img = cv2.imdecode(data, cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
        if img is None:
            raise ValueError("decode failed")
        h, w = img.shape[:2]
        gray = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
        if h * w > 0:
            white_ratio = float(np.sum(gray > 200)) / float(h * w)
    except Exception:
        pass

    ocr_lower = ocr_text.lower()
    ocr_lines = [line.strip() for line in ocr_text.split('\n') if line.strip()]

    numeric_tokens = re.findall(r'^\d+\.?\d*$', ocr_text, re.MULTILINE)
    has_axis_numbers = len(numeric_tokens) >= 2

    exp_kw = [
        "epoch", "epochs", "accuracy", "loss", "precision", "recall",
        "f1", "f1-score", "auc", "training", "validation", "performance",
        "curve", "comparison", "results", "baseline", "top-1", "top-5"
    ]
    arch_kw = [
        "cnn", "transformer", "attention", "encoder", "decoder", "block",
        "embedding", "classifier", "feature extractor", "alexnet", "resnet",
        "vgg", "googlenet", "conv", "pool", "layer", "relu", "softmax",
        "dropout", "lstm", "gru", "bilstm", "rnn", "densenet", "mobilenet",
        "efficientnet", "bert", "gpt"
    ]
    ds_kw = [
        "dataset", "sample", "data sample", "input example",
        "class image", "label", "training set", "test set"
    ]

    has_exp = any(kw in ocr_lower for kw in exp_kw)
    has_arch = any(kw in ocr_lower for kw in arch_kw)
    has_ds = any(kw in ocr_lower for kw in ds_kw)

    strong_exp = False
    if "epoch" in ocr_lower:
        strong_exp = True
    if any(kw in ocr_lower for kw in ["accuracy", "loss", "precision", "recall", "f1", "auc"]):
        strong_exp = True

    chart_like = has_axis_numbers and white_ratio > 0.4

    img_type = "other"

    if strong_exp or (has_exp and chart_like):
        img_type = "experiment_result"
    elif has_arch and not strong_exp:
        img_type = "architecture"
    elif has_ds and not strong_exp and not has_arch:
        img_type = "dataset"
    elif chart_like and not has_arch:
        img_type = "experiment_result"

    if img_type == "experiment_result":
        components = []

        metric_map = {
            "accuracy": "Accuracy", "loss": "Loss", "precision": "Precision",
            "recall": "Recall", "f1-score": "F1-score", "f1": "F1-score",
            "auc": "AUC", "top-1": "Top-1 Accuracy", "top-5": "Top-5 Accuracy"
        }
        for key, val in metric_map.items():
            if key in ocr_lower and val not in components:
                components.append(val)

        model_name_map = {
            "alexnet": "AlexNet", "resnet": "ResNet", "vgg": "VGG",
            "googlenet": "GoogLeNet", "transformer": "Transformer",
            "cnn": "CNN", "lstm": "LSTM", "gru": "GRU",
            "densenet": "DenseNet", "mobilenet": "MobileNet",
            "efficientnet": "EfficientNet", "bert": "BERT"
        }
        for key, val in model_name_map.items():
            if key in ocr_lower and val not in components:
                components.append(val)

        skip_lower = {"epoch", "epochs", "dataset type", "accuracy", "loss",
                      "precision", "recall", "f1", "f1-score", "auc",
                      "training", "validation", "test", "performance"}
        for line in ocr_lines:
            if not re.match(r'^\d+\.?\d*$', line) and line.lower() not in skip_lower:
                if line not in components and len(line) > 1:
                    components.append(line)

        if "epoch" in ocr_lower:
            desc = "展示不同数据集类型在训练过程中的性能变化曲线"
            parts = [c for c in components if c not in ("Accuracy", "Loss")]
            if parts:
                code_info = (
                    "需要实现训练循环和评估模块，分别对"
                    + "、".join(parts)
                    + "等数据类型进行训练，在每个Epoch记录性能指标并绘制对比曲线"
                )
            else:
                code_info = "需要实现训练循环，在每个Epoch记录性能指标并绘制对比曲线"
        else:
            desc = "展示实验结果和性能指标比较"
            code_info = "需要实现实验评估模块，输出各项性能指标用于对比分析"

        result = {
            "type": "experiment_result",
            "description": desc,
            "important_components": components,
            "code_relevant_information": code_info
        }

    elif img_type == "architecture":
        components = []
        arch_map = {
            "alexnet": "AlexNet", "resnet": "ResNet", "vgg": "VGG",
            "googlenet": "GoogLeNet", "transformer": "Transformer",
            "cnn": "CNN", "attention": "Attention Module",
            "encoder": "Encoder", "decoder": "Decoder",
            "block": "Block", "embedding": "Embedding",
            "classifier": "Classifier", "feature extractor": "Feature Extractor",
            "lstm": "LSTM", "gru": "GRU", "bilstm": "BiLSTM",
            "densenet": "DenseNet", "mobilenet": "MobileNet",
            "efficientnet": "EfficientNet", "bert": "BERT", "gpt": "GPT"
        }
        for key, val in arch_map.items():
            if key in ocr_lower and val not in components:
                components.append(val)

        if components:
            code_info = "需要实现以下模型组件：" + "、".join(components)
        else:
            code_info = "需要实现论文中描述的模型网络结构"

        result = {
            "type": "architecture",
            "description": "展示模型网络结构和数据流关系",
            "important_components": components,
            "code_relevant_information": code_info
        }

    elif img_type == "dataset":
        desc_parts = []
        if "sample" in ocr_lower:
            desc_parts.append("数据样本")
        if "class" in ocr_lower or "label" in ocr_lower:
            desc_parts.append("类别标签")
        if not desc_parts:
            desc_parts.append("数据集信息")

        result = {
            "type": "dataset",
            "description": "展示数据集样本和" + "、".join(desc_parts) + "信息",
            "important_components": [],
            "code_relevant_information": "需要实现数据加载和预处理模块"
        }

    try:
        print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
    except Exception:
        print(json.dumps({
            "type": "other",
            "description": "无法确定图片类型",
            "important_components": [],
            "code_relevant_information": ""
        }, ensure_ascii=False))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except Exception:
        print(json.dumps({
            "type": "other",
            "description": "无法确定图片类型",
            "important_components": [],
            "code_relevant_information": ""
        }, ensure_ascii=False))
```
